This [[Technologies|technology tree]] deals with the [[church]] and [[graveyard]]. It is unlocked by first meeting the [[bishop]]. Through it you can unlock better [[gravestone]]s and [[Stone grave fence|fences]] for a better {{Graveyard Rating}}, new items for the [[church]] to help you boost its rating and new [[sermon]]s which give unique bonuses.

==Faith==
This branch is unlocked after completing the [[Episcop#Fix_the_graveyard|bishops quest]] to raise {{Graveyard Rating}} to 5. He will give you the [[Perks|preacher perk]] allowing you to hold [[sermons]] in the local [[church]]. Further down the tree you are able to craft more sermons.

==Graves==
Upon arriving to the graveyard for the first time the [[Episcop#Fix_the_graveyard|bishop]] will ask you to the be the graveyard keeper. You gain access to the [[Technologies|technology tree]] so that you can improve the [[graveyard]] to 5 {{Graveyard Rating}} and complete his quest. Unlocking all of these technology's costs a total of [[File:Red Tech Symbol.png]] [[Technologies|'''1455,''']] [[File:Green Tech Symbol.png]] [[Technologies|'''155''']], and [[File:Blue Tech Symbol.png]] '''[[Technologies|635]]''' technology points.
